Combine the members' out-of-fold predictions

Source: R/ensemble.R
ensemble_oof_predictions.Rd

Every member was cross-validated on the same folds from the same seed, so their held-out predictions cover the same rows and can be combined row by row. Matched on .row rather than on position, since tune returns folds in its own order and two members need not agree on it.

Usage

ensemble_oof_predictions(members, weights, rule = "weighted_mean")

Arguments

members

the qualifying fit_patch_model() results

weights

their weights

rule

one of ensemble_rules()

Value

a data frame of .row, patch and .pred_patch, in the shape the evaluation functions expect
